summary_1line: Krishna consoles grieving Arjuna over Abhimanyu’s death; Yudhishthira recounts the boy’s heroic fall, and Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha the next day.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, eyes streaming with tears, sits gripping his bow and sword while the silent Pandava warriors stand around him unable to meet his gaze.
Young Abhimanyu, surrounded by six great chariot-warriors after his chariot is shattered, fights on alone in the midst of a ring of enemies.
Arjuna rises trembling with rage, swearing before the assembled warriors that he will slay Jayadratha by the next day’s sunset.
